title: Sagrada Família · Interior
description: Through the Nativity portal into the basilica: the forest of columns in four stones branching into the vault, the cool glass on the Nativity side and the warm glass on the Passion side with their light pooled on the floor, the crossing's porphyry columns and their Evangelists, the altar under its canopy with the organ behind, the crypt's grille, the Glory's rose and bronze doors, the overview, and back out the same door.

steps.caption: Through the Nativity portal: daylight on the threshold, the sign asking for silence, the cool glass of the Nativity side and the first columns
Under the crossing: the four porphyry columns and the basalt round them, visitors looking up, the gold light of the lantern on the floor
The presbytery behind its rope and guard: the porphyry altar under the seven-sided canopy, Christ hanging under it, the organ behind
A porphyry column's knot with Luke's lit oval, the branches rising into the vault
The Passion side: tall windows of red, orange and yellow glass, their light lying warm on the floor
Right behind a sandstone column: its trunk opens round Gerard, as the branches and the vault do, so the forest never hides him
The Nativity side: the low wall's band of blue and green glass and its cool light on the floor
The Glory's inner wall: the great rose, the gallery and the bronze doors with the Lord's Prayer in Catalan
The ambulatory behind the altar: the crypt's grille, the apse's gold glass, the organ's pipes
Down the nave: rows of chairs between the granite columns, the vault's cells opening round Gerard
The overview (R): the Latin cross, the forest of columns and the vault's cells, the warm glass standing tall on the far walls
Back out through the Nativity, at the foot of the portal's steps facing the queue

steps.eval: { const app = window.gerard.game.app; const pre = document.createElement('pre'); pre.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:24px;bottom:24px;z-index:99999;margin:0;padding:12px 16px;background:#101f25ee;color:#eeeade;font:14px/1.5 ui-monospace,monospace'; pre.textContent = `draw calls ${app.stats.drawCalls.total} · frame ${app.stats.frame.ms.toFixed(1)} ms`; document.body.append(pre); }

steps.caption: Draw calls and frame time following Gerard under the crossing
